organization.capital.description: Central liquid capital account of the organization. If <= 0.0 at organization ecology evaluation, triggers deterministic capital collapse.

manpower.supply_reserve.description: Locality-indexed buffer of supply/equipment dedicated to unfielded recruits or awaiting formation transfer.

counters.recruitment.description: Simulation-wide counter incremented by represented population recruited.

fielded_personnel.description: Sum of personnel across active, operational, inside-pineland formations belonging to the insurgent organization.

collapse_causes.stochastic: collapse_draw < collapse_hazard at weekly ecology check

ledger_terms.units: capital units converted to supply units
ledger_terms.exact_formula: converted = min(max(manpower.pool * supply_per_fighter - manpower.supply_reserve, 0.0), max(capital, 0.0)); capital -= converted
ledger_terms.notes: Exact SL4 conversion. Under balanced reserve, converted = recruit_fighters * formation_supply_days * initial_supply_fraction = represented_recruits * fighter_conversion_fraction * 30.0 * 0.8 = represented_recruits * 1.92.
Endogenous recurring revenue from local territorial and fiscal control.
Default insurgent external_support is 10,000.0/year -> 833.333 units per 30-day cycle.

ledger_terms.exact_formula: total = foreign.resources * budget_fraction * willingness; financial = total * 0.22; capital[recipient] += financial
ledger_terms.notes: Active only when foreign_affairs.enabled is true. In core discovery family, foreign affairs is disabled to isolate internal metabolic burn; held-out family H2 activates external mechanisms.
Applies only to newly birthed organizations, not the focal incumbent insurgent.

ledger_terms.notes: Audited: Formations consume physical supply_stock via logistics.rs, but pay zero liquid capital maintenance.

ledger_terms.exact_formula: 0.0 capital impact (logistics moves physical supplies without charging liquid capital)
ledger_terms.notes: Audited: Logistics affects physical supply quantities, not organizations.capital.

ledger_terms.notes: Audited: Insurgents pay zero liquid capital for combat casualties or engagements.

conclusions: Insurgent organization capital has exactly ONE recurring outflow: recruitment supply conversion in recruitment.rs.
Insurgent organization capital has exactly TWO baseline recurring inflows in economy.rs: local fiscal extraction (endogenous) and external support (exogenous).
When foreign_affairs is enabled, dynamic transfers can provide an additional inflow via foreign.rs.
No maintenance, logistics transport fees, or combat casualty cash penalties exist for the insurgent.
The conversion factor between represented recruits and liquid capital is exactly fighter_conversion_fraction * formation_supply_days * initial_supply_fraction = 0.08 * 30 * 0.8 = 1.92 under defaults.
The capital equation in the research task is strictly verified by source code audit.
